goal.insight: Show the simultaneous multi-indicator deterioration of ocean health from 1990 to 2024 by overlaying four time series with independent y-axes so their contrasting trend directions are visually apparent
Emphasize the accelerating decline in coral cover percentage, particularly the steepening drop after 2015
Highlight the upward trajectory of sea surface temperature anomaly, drawing attention to the sharp increase in the most recent years
Make the near-exponential growth curve of ocean plastic pollution visually prominent against the other more gradual trends
Use distinct axis scales, colors, and line styles for each of the four indicators so viewers can compare trend shapes despite different units (°C anomaly, pH, %, million metric tons)
